name: 📞 KOOK — Bakery voice call (ElevenLabs, Bland backup)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_id: $json.elevenlabs_agent_id, agent_phone_number_id: $json.elevenlabs_phone_number_id, to_number: $json.to_number, conversation_initiation_client_data: { dynamic_variables: { bakery_name: $json.bakery_name, order: $json.order, pickup_minutes: $json.pickup_minutes, customer_name: $json.customer_name } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ phone_number: $json.to_number, task: 'You are Kook, a calm, polite AI assistant with a dry, faintly British manner, a bit like a very capable butler. You are calling ' + $json.bakery_name + ' on behalf of ' + $json.customer_name + '. Wait for them to greet you and only carry on if a real person answers; if it is voicemail, hang up and leave no message. Order ' + $json.order + ' for pickup in about ' + $json.pickup_minutes + ' minutes under the name ' + $json.customer_name + '. If they ask, say you are an AI assistant ordering for ' + $json.customer_name + '. Read the order and pickup time back, thank them and end the call. Keep it short.', voice: $json.bland_voice, first_sentence: 'Good morning. I am calling on behalf of ' + $json.customer_name + '. Could I order ' + $json.order + ' for pickup please?', wait_for_greeting: true, max_duration: 3, answered_by_enabled: true, voicemail_action: 'hangup', record: false, model: 'turbo', metadata: { job: 'bakery' }, analysis_schema: { order_confirmed: 'boolean', pickup_time: 'string' }, webhook: 'https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/call-results' }) }}

parameters.text: =📞 Kook is ringing {{ $('Call details').first().json.bakery_name }} ({{ $('Call details').first().json.provider }}) for {{ $('Call details').first().json.order }}, pickup in {{ $('Call details').first().json.pickup_minutes }} min.
